School ofPharmacy，Central South University，Changsha 410013，China)ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE: To introduce the research progress on P-glycoprotein-mediated drug interactions． METHODS: Based on recent representative papers both at home and abroad，the properties，functions and action mechanism of P-glycoprotein and their application in drug interaction was analyzed and reviewed． RESULTS: Pglycoprotein was found to be able to mediate drug interactions of such drugs as anti-tumor drugs，circulatory system drugs，antibiotics，immunomodulators and central nervous system drugs etc． CONCLUSION: There is lack of in-depth and systematic research on the drug interactions mediated by P-glycoprotein．P-糖蛋白(P-gp)是一种 ATP 依赖性的外向型转运泵，分布于全身多个重要脏器中，参与多类药物的体内转运过程，由多药耐药( multidrug resistance，MDR) 基因编码的，也是抗抗肿瘤药产生多药耐药作用的主要原因。
